title: FPAC® Certification (Certified Corporate FP&A Professional)
source: AFP FPAC Candidate Handbook & Exam Blueprint
summary: The premier global credential dedicated to corporate Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), encompassing financial acumen, technology, predictive modeling, variance analysis, and strategic business partnering across Parts I & II.

standard.name: Standard Corporate FP&A Track
standard.blurb: Pass Part I (Financial Acumen & Technology) and Part II (Strategic Analysis & Business Partnering) and document 2 to 3 years of qualifying FP&A experience.

stages.title: Stage 1: Part I – Financial Acumen, Information Management & Technology
stages.subtitle: Data gathering, financial statement modeling, and systems (125 MCQs | 2.5 Hours)

nodes.name: Part I Curriculum: Financial Acumen & Modeling Tools
nodes.description: Gathering and organizing financial/operational data, understanding macroeconomic indicators, three-statement financial modeling, Excel/BI tools, and corporate governance.
topics: Gathering, Cleansing & Organizing Enterprise Operational and Financial Data
Macroeconomic and Microeconomic Analysis for Business Forecasting
Financial Statement Dynamics: Interconnecting Income Statement, Balance Sheet & Cash Flow
ERP Data Extraction, Business Intelligence (BI) & Financial Modeling Technology

nodes.name: FPAC Part I Examination Sitting
nodes.description: Computer-based examination testing financial acumen, data governance, and technology tools. Scaled passing score: 500 out of 800.

stages.title: Stage 2: Part II – Financial Analysis, Projections & Strategy
stages.subtitle: Driver-based budgeting, variance analysis, scenario modeling, and strategy (3.5 Hours)

nodes.name: Part II Curriculum: Projections, Strategy & Partnering
nodes.description: Driver-based budgeting, rolling forecasts, variance analysis (price/volume/mix), capital budgeting (NPV/IRR), scenario modeling, and executive storytelling/business partnering.
topics: Building Dynamic Driver-Based Budgets & Rolling Forecast Architectures
Multi-Factor Variance Analysis: Price, Volume, Mix, and Foreign Exchange Shifts
Capital Budgeting Decisions: Discounted Cash Flows, Hurdle Rates & Payback
Strategic Business Partnering, Executive Dashboards & Board-Level Storytelling

nodes.name: FPAC Part II Examination Sitting
nodes.format: Case Studies, Spreadsheet Simulations & Multiple-Choice Questions
nodes.description: Computer-based testing evaluating complex financial case studies, spreadsheet simulation modeling, and strategic business analysis. Scaled passing score: 500 out of 800.

nodes.name: 2 to 3 Years Corporate FP&A Work Experience
nodes.description: Demonstrate qualifying full-time professional experience in corporate financial planning, variance analysis, financial modeling, or strategic budgeting.

nodes.name: Certified FP&A Professional Conferred & Ethics
nodes.description: Conferral of the FPAC credential. Maintenance requires 45 approved recertification credits every 3 years and commitment to the AFP Standards of Ethical Conduct.
